column6: the dataset's note 'likely Darius I, son of Xerxes' is wrong twice: Darius I was the son of Hystaspes and the father of Xerxes, and the Mede of Daniel, son of Ahasuerus of the seed of the Medes (DAN 9:1), takes the kingdom when Babylon falls (DAN 5:30-31), before Cyrus (DAN 6:28), while Darius I reigned after Cyrus and Cambyses; the note now says what Daniel says of him
